title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: CD -> EAC(secure, offset corrected) -> TLH(flac encoding) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard recording of a strong 1970 show with standout acoustic Truckin, Not Fade Away and rare Pigpen organ moments, though vocals are low and some listeners find the tape imperfect.
ai_review.review: The set shines thanks to impressive acoustic numbers – a rare acoustic Truckin, a soaring Not Fade Away, and St. Stephen at its mid‑70s peak – plus Pigpen’s organ sitting unusually front‑center. The soundboard source is audible but uneven, with low vocals and occasional “insane” glitches that keep it from being a pristine listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is highly praised (many standout songs, strong acoustic set) while recording quality is noted as only fair due to low vocals and occasional glitches; overall rating leans positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals a little low, but organ and drums clear; some listeners note the tape is “insane” or not fully listenable, yet overall more audible than other versions.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road Feelin' Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic sets are highlighted as impressive and rare, with the electric set described as “fire”; overall pacing is praised despite recording quirks.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is fully in the mix—a rarity for 1970/71 recordings.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy Kreutzmann keeps a nice beat, especially on Truckin.
